summary: Created the appworker account on node1 (AlmaLinux 9) and configured a login-session resource limit of 8,192 open files and 256 processes via /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf, enforced through pam_limits in system-auth. Verified the limits apply to appworker's login sessions, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, triggered a native reboot (shutdown -r now) whose acknowledgement returned before disconnection, polled until the node was reachable again, confirmed the boot_id changed (proving an actual restart, not just elapsed time), and re-verified post-restart that the appworker account, its limits config, and enforced ulimits (nofile=8192, nproc=256) all survived and remain correct.
actions_performed: Checked OS, sudo access, and confirmed appworker did not already exist (cmd-7d84f0b1929e4921)
Created appworker user with home directory via useradd -m (cmd-d905432bcb114139)
Wrote /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf with soft/hard nofile=8192 and soft/hard nproc=256 (cmd-b1af08a6510a4616)
Verified pam_limits is wired into system-auth and confirmed effective ulimits for appworker via sudo -u appworker -i (cmd-c3bf1ff668af4271)
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, uptime, passwd entry, and limits file content (cmd-d2332159610d4720)
Triggered native reboot (shutdown -r now) backgrounded so acknowledgement returned before disconnect (cmd-ed805e57d4124d42)
Polled node1 until reachable again; first poll timed out (node still rebooting) (cmd-2f964946574c49de), second poll succeeded with a new boot_id (cmd-fa5df62ff8e74c66)
Post-restart verification of appworker account, limits config file, and enforced ulimits (cmd-f0b2f1ba4115465b)

evidence.summary: Confirmed appworker did not exist beforehand, then created it with useradd -m and verified uid/gid assignment.

evidence.requirement: Login sessions limited to 8,192 open files and 256 processes
evidence.summary: Wrote limits.d drop-in with nofile/nproc limits and verified via sudo -u appworker -i that ulimit -n returns 8192 and ulimit -u returns 256, with pam_limits confirmed active in system-auth.
Captured boot_id f54d7366-..., uptime, appworker passwd entry, and limits file contents before restart.
Issued backgrounded shutdown -r now; command returned before the exec stream closed due to the reboot severing the connection, indicating the reboot proceeded.

evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity (actual restart, not just downtime)
evidence.summary: First poll timed out while node was down; second poll succeeded and returned a new boot_id (4dcef926-...), differing from the pre-restart boot_id, proving a genuine reboot.

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of appworker account and its resource limits
evidence.summary: After restart, getent passwd shows appworker intact, limits.d file content unchanged, and sudo -u appworker -i ulimit checks confirm nofile=8192 and nproc=256 still enforced.
